This '''Dragon Lord''' was the leader of the [[Dragon Lords]] of [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]].

==Biography==
Shortly before the [[Battle of Drexel]], this dragon lord saved a drowning [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Quarg]] fired upon the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]. Awakening, Han Solo was briefed upon why the [[Sonic jammer]]s cause a disruption for the [[Sea-dragon]]s. This Dragon Lord escorted Solo to Quarg's [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship, where they were successfully able to destroy the sonic-jammer and defeat Quarg.<ref name="MSW14" /> The Dragon Lord thanked Solo for his help while he went to defeat [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]].<ref name="MSW15">[[Star Wars (1977) 15|''Star Wars'' (1977) 15]]</ref>
